acceptanceCriteria: internal/companionrelease recognizes the exact cem/1.0 stable result schema and mode and refuses incomplete runner, platform and external outcomes and unsupported admission even when reference integrity passes, with tests; MIGRATION.json A02 moves out of OPEN

A release gate runs the protocol/cem-1.0 sealed suites (tamper matrix, citation vectors, neutral criterion, receipt authentication, repository envelope) against the built release binaries of corvint and cem01-go and refuses when their builds differ
Spec rows and rollback recorded; owner promotion is not implied
body: Found by the V1-0595 closeout audit (2026-10-21, origin/main ef2a01db5). protocol/cem-1.0/stable/MIGRATION.json laterAdditions A02 (companion release Core evidence readers, internal/companionrelease/core_evidence.go and core_native_json.go) is status OPEN: those readers use wire.Parse only as a strict JSON parser and never recognize the exact stable result schema/mode or its authority, runtime and envelope limits. V1-0596 criterion 2 needs portable conformance and the required release gates run on the final artifact set. Expected: release readiness reads the exact cem/1.0 stable result of the release artifacts, refuses incomplete runner/platform/external outcomes and unsupported admission even when reference integrity passes, and the protocol/cem-1.0 portable suites run against the shipped corvint and cem01-go binaries. Actual: no reader and no such gate. Related: V1-1761 (cem01-go build skew), V1-0019/V1-0020 (owner release steps). Dedupe: searched OPEN for companionrelease, A02, release readiness, portable conformance and final artifact; none covers it.
title: Release readiness does not read cem/1.0 stable results (MIGRATION A02 OPEN) and no gate runs the portable conformance packet over the final release artifacts
